summary: Reliance Global Group subsidiary Altruis Benefit Consultants sold substantially all assets of its employee benefits insurance agency to Altruis Benefit Management, LLC (sole member Trent D. Bryson) for $8,000,000, signed and closed September 23, 2026. Consideration: $4,440,782.60 cash, $3,097,488.40 secured promissory note maturing September 30, 2026, $300,000 indemnity holdback (12 months), $161,729 working capital holdback, plus up to $1,000,000 earnout over three annual periods on 10-15-20% revenue growth, subordinated to buyer senior debt. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch note repayment speed, holdback release, earnout attainment, and buyer credit risk.
